q_en:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A) His relentless pursuit of perfection often left him frustrated, as the more he worked, the farther he seemed from his goal.
B) Despite this, he refused to give up, believing that every failure brought him closer to his ideal outcome.
C) Yet, he had learned a valuable lesson over the years—that success wasn’t just about the destination but also about the journey itself.
D) In the beginning, he had been driven solely by the desire to succeed, thinking that achieving his goal would solve everything.
E) As he reflected on his journey, he realised that the process of striving had shaped him in ways that success alone never could.
q_hi:

B) Despite this, he refused to give up, believing that every failure brought him closer to his ideal outcome.
C) Yet, he had learned a valuable lesson over the years—that success wasn’t just about the destination but also about the journey itself.
D) In the beginning, he had been driven solely by the desire to succeed, thinking that achieving his goal would solve everything.
E) As he reflected on his journey, he realised that the process of striving had shaped him in ways that success alone never could.
section: Test of English Language and Comprehension1
solution:
1. वाक्य A विषय का परिचय देता है (परफेक्शन की खोज)।
2. वाक्य B 'Despite this' के साथ उसकी दृढ़ता को दर्शाता है।
3. वाक्य D उसकी शुरुआती सोच बताता है।
4. वाक्य C एक बदलाव 'Yet' और सीख को दर्शाता है।
5. वाक्य E निष्कर्ष के रूप में आत्म-चिंतन को दर्शाता है।
6. सही क्रम ABDCE एक तार्किक कहानी बनाता है।
